effect_description_eng:
[On Play] By returning the top card of your security stack to your hand, you may place 1 yellow card with the [Vaccine] trait from your hand at the bottom of your security stack.
[Your Turn] When a card is added to your security stack, you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 Memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
